content.value: A car sounding a horn producing a note of 550 Hz approaches and then passes a (10) stationary observer at a steady speed of 24 m/s. What will be the frequencies apparent to the observer when the car is (i) approaching and (ii) receding? What is the interval between these two notes? (Velocity of sound = 340 m/s).

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
